meta.description: Draft, restructure, or plan Nature-style manuscript sections and initial-submission materials from author-provided claims, results, figures, notes, or Chinese drafts. Five-axis routing (task: manuscript/submission-package, paper_type: 5 types, section: 8 sections, language: en/zh-to-en, journal: 5 types). Enforces core stance (surface missing claim/evidence/boundary before drafting), workflow (intake → plan → draft → audit), main-text discipline (shortest sufficient evidence chain, Results classification, prevent revision accretion). Integrates Nature-style corpus guidance (abstract, introduction, results-discussion).

scientific_integrity.detail: Surfaces missing claim/evidence/boundary before drafting. Does not invent experiments, citations, numeric results. Placeholder + 'Assumptions or missing inputs' for missing content. Main-text discipline prevents inflating evidence. Claim escalation bounded by evidence. Does not equate complete analysis record with complete main text.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for manuscript drafting. Submission-package separate from revision correspondence (routes to nature-response). Corpus guidance labeled as distilled patterns (not official policy). Journal rules override corpus patterns. Self-review/rejection-risk audit available but not default.

methodological_ground.detail: Core stance workflow sound (intake → plan → draft → audit). Main-text discipline rigorous (classify results, allocate to main/captions/Methods/SI, shortest sufficient chain). Paper-type playbooks with evidence-chain architecture. Claim escalation from corpus patterns evidence-based. Paragraph-necessity test prevents bloat.

code_usability.detail: Five-step routing protocol clear. Manifest-driven fragment loading. Always-load core layer. On-demand references (10 conditions). Submission-package deliverable matrix and readiness audit. Examples library (references/examples/index.md).

recommendations.title: Add concrete remediation examples in paper-review rejection-risk audit
recommendations.problem: Self-review identifies rejection risks (novelty positioning weak, figure legend incomplete) with high-level suggestions ('strengthen positioning', 'complete legend') but lacks concrete remediation examples (comparison table structure, which citations to add, legend template).
recommendations.root_cause: paper-review.md focuses on risk identification, not remediation operationalization.
recommendations.fix: Enhance references/paper-review.md with remediation library: (1) for each common risk type (weak novelty, incomplete methods, overreach claim, missing control), provide concrete fix template (novelty: comparison table showing prior work vs this work on 3-4 dimensions + cite key papers; methods: add equipment models, reagent catalog numbers, software versions), (2) include before/after examples, (3) generate 'Suggested fixes' subsection under each risk in audit output with actionable text snippets.

recommendations.title: Add submission-package readiness audit details
recommendations.problem: Submission-package workflow mentions 'readiness audit' (checked 7/8 complete) but audit criteria not detailed. What makes cover letter ready? Title page? Each deliverable has different completeness criteria.
recommendations.root_cause: references/submission-package.md documents deliverable matrix but audit checklist per deliverable not fully specified.
recommendations.fix: Add to references/submission-package.md: per-deliverable readiness checklist (cover letter: journal name, editor if known, 2-3 sentence pitch, novelty statement, fit justification; title page: all authors with affiliations, ORCIDs, corresponding author marked, word count; highlights: 3-5 bullets <85 chars, no references; etc.). Generate audit report with per-deliverable status (✓ ready, ⚠ incomplete, ✗ missing) before package delivery.

recommendations.title: Expand examples library with section-specific templates
recommendations.problem: references/examples/index.md mentioned as examples library but not detailed. Users requesting templates for specific sections (Methods for computational study, Discussion for negative result, Introduction for interdisciplinary paper) lack concrete examples.
recommendations.root_cause: Examples library index present but content not fully developed.
recommendations.fix: Populate references/examples/ with 20+ worked examples organized by paper_type × section: (1) research/methods: computational study template, experimental protocol template; (2) research/discussion: negative result framing, interdisciplinary synthesis; (3) hypothesis/intro: gap identification for hypothesis paper; (4) algorithmic/results: ablation study presentation. Each example 200-400 words with annotations explaining structural choices. Update index.md with taxonomy and access paths.
